correctness.rationale: The toric formula correctly specializes to \(R=(r+2)/(r+a+b)\). Using the canonical region \(0\le d=b-a\le r\), \(1\le a\le r+d\), normalized lattice points converge to uniform area on the stated triangle. Intersecting \(x+2y\le L\) with that triangle gives the displayed piecewise survival law, and direct integration gives mean \(\log3/3\). The verifier checks the Reid--Tai region, exact counts/extrema, survival continuity, and mean convergence.
residual_risks: No correctness defect; rejection is implication/value based.

originality.rationale: Li gives the toric barycenter formula for the greatest Ricci lower bound and Berman--Berndtsson extend it to toric log Fano varieties. Separately, the already published Resultary record 'A triangular classification of canonical and terminal two-heavy weighted projective spaces' gives exactly the canonical lattice region used here. Once those prior inputs are combined, the limiting distribution is the elementary push-forward of uniform lattice points in a triangle under \(1/(1+x+2y)\); the survival pieces and mean are routine polygon-area and integral calculations.
